Name: Shammoth the Harorite
Summary: Valient man of David's armies, called the Harorite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:27: Valient man of David's armies, called the Harorite.
LifeLesson: The mention of Shammoth in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
